concept.title: 1. Getting ready to remotely move forward and backward

conbody.p: There are two ways to operate Remote Operation function.

section.title: Method (1): Using the function with vehicle off

li.p: Within a certain range from the vehicle press the door lock () button on the smart key or digital key and lock all doors.
Press and hold the Remote Start button () within 4 seconds until the vehicle starts.

section.p: For more details on remotely starting the vehicle, refer to .

section.title: Method (2): Using the function with vehicle on

p.uicontrol: 1. Leave the vehicle (keep the key) and close the doors.
2. Press and hold the parking button on the Smart Key.

li.p: Park the vehicle in front of the space where you want to use Remote Operation function, and shift the gear to P (Park).
Press and hold the Parking/View () button to turn on Smart Parking Assist. A message Under REMOTE control will appear on the infotainment system screen.
Get out of the vehicle with the smart key or digital key and close all doors.
Agree must be selected on the infotainment system screen and the infotainment system has to operate properly to use Remote Operation function.

Before starting to move the vehicle using the Remote Forward/Reverse function from outside the vehicle, make sure that no Smart Key or digital key is left inside the vehicle. If a spare Smart Key or digital key remains inside the vehicle, the Remote Forward/Reverse function will not operate.
